version.approval_notes: Source: https://github.com/GRASTROY-Creations/feed_tubes. Build with Bun 1.4.4: `bun install`, then `bun run build:ext`; output is `build/`. Upload `dist/feedtubes-<version>.zip`. The source zip is a git archive: manifest at `src/manifest.json`, not the root. No data collection.

summary.en-US: One sidebar for the channels you follow on YouTube, PeerTube, Odysee, Twitch and more. No account, no algorithm, no tracking — just the newest videos from your subscriptions.

description.en-US: FeedTubes brings PeerTube, Odysee, Rutube, Dailymotion, D.Tube, Pixabay, goodgame.ru, VK Video, Bilibili and RSS/Atom subscriptions, plus YouTube, into one Firefox sidebar. No account, no algorithm, no tracking, no server.
